request.description: I, Pencil: a pencil supply chain that keeps running. Loggers cut cedar in Oregon, a mill saws it into slats, graphite is mined in Sri Lanka and mixed with clay into leads, a factory in Pennsylvania glues leads into slats, paints them and adds erasers and brass ferrules, packs them into boxes, and trucks deliver the boxes to shops across the country, which sell them to customers.

starved_holders: make-leads needs clay at lead-maker, which starts with none and nothing ever gives it any

review_findings.problem: The lead maker starts with 0 clay and there is no rule to supply or mine any, making this move impossible from the start.

review_findings.description_words: a factory in Pennsylvania glues leads into slats, paints them and adds erasers and brass ferrules, packs them into boxes
review_findings.problem: The description states the factory packs the pencils into boxes, but the rules assign this task to a separate packer business.
Selling a pencil destroys a packed box, reducing the total of the boxes resource, but the boxes law does not list this move and will refuse it.

review_findings.description_words: a mill saws it into slats
review_findings.problem: There is no rule to move logs from the loggers to the mill, so the mill can never get logs to saw.
There is no rule to move graphite from the miner to the lead maker, so they cannot acquire it to mix with clay.
There is no rule to move leads from the lead maker or slats from the mill to the factory.
The rule only allows buying paint, so the factory has no way to acquire the erasers and ferrules it needs to make pencils.
There is no rule to move pencils from the factory or boxes from the supplier to the packer.

review_findings.description_words: trucks deliver the boxes to shops
review_findings.problem: The rule starts a delivery but does not actually move any boxes or pencils to the shops.
The shop starts with 0 pencils and no rule ever delivers any to it, making this move impossible from the start.

laws.says: Logs are made by cutting cedar, used in sawing slats, and otherwise only transferred.
Slats are made by sawing logs, used in making pencils, and otherwise only transferred.
Graphite is made by mining and used in making leads; otherwise it is only transferred.
Clay is a represented starting stock used in making leads.
Leads are made by mixing materials, used in making pencils, and otherwise only transferred.
Paint is supplied as stock and used in making pencils; otherwise it is only transferred.
Erasers are supplied as stock and used in making pencils; otherwise they are only transferred.
Ferrules are supplied as stock and used in making pencils; otherwise they are only transferred.
Pencils are made in the factory and packed into boxes; otherwise they are only transferred or sold.
Boxes are supplied, used to pack pencils, and otherwise only transferred.
